arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 -c "import resource; print(resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)"; python3 -c "print('hi')"; cat > /tmp/dev/runlimit.py <<'EOF'
import sys, json, time, resource, os
from limits import apply
apply()
t0=time.time()
sys.path.insert(0, os.environ['SUB'])
sys.argv=['main.py']
import runpy
data=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
sys.stdin=type('S',(),{'read':lambda self: data.decode()})()
import io
buf=io.StringIO()
old=sys.stdout; sys.stdout=buf
runpy.run_path(os.path.join(os.environ['SUB'],'main.py'), run_name='__main__')
sys.stdout=old
print(f'wall {time.time()-t0:.2f}s cpu {time.process_time():.2f}s out {len(buf.getvalue())}B', file=sys.stderr)
sys.stdout.write(buf.getvalue())
EOF
echo ok
